body:
Part of #2390.

## Problem

A controller cannot send a message to, queue for, steer, or interrupt a remote chat agent. The only input path the controller uses is `pty:input`, which has no effect on a chat agent.

## Established (origin/main 91da2bc6)

- WS `pty:input` → `ptyManager.write(agentId, inputData)` (`annex-server.ts:2287-2297`). `write` returns when there is no PTY session (`pty-manager.ts:549-551`), so keystrokes from the controller's terminal vanish.
- `POST /api/v1/agents/:id/message` (`annex-server.ts:1710-1745`) does reach the chat runtime: `runtime.sendMessage(message, { source: 'annex' })` at `:1727`. It is mTLS-gated (`:1711`). The desktop controller never calls it: there is no message method in `src/preload/annexClient.ts` or `annex-client.ts`.
- That route differs from the local send path in `src/main/ipc/chat-handlers.ts:143-160`:
  - It takes text only, with no `delivery` (`auto` / `prompt` / `steer` / `queued`), so the caller cannot choose steer vs queue. The runtime still picks one by capability (`chat-runtime.ts:527-529`).
  - It skips the `/clear` special case (`chat-handlers.ts:150-153`, which calls `runtime.clearContext()`), so `/clear` from Annex goes to the CLI as plain text.
  - It skips the "revert running" guard (`chat-handlers.ts:148`).
  - It returns `{ ok, agentId, mode }` and drops the runtime's `{ delivery, messageId }` result.
- `ChatAgentRuntime.interrupt()` (`chat-runtime.ts:581-588`) has no Annex route. Interrupt falls back to `stop()` when the driver can't interrupt.
- The runtime's local queue (`chat-runtime.ts:539-543`) emits a `user_message` with `delivery: 'queued'`, so queued messages show up through `chat:event` once forwarding exists. There is no route to cancel or reorder a queued message (none exists locally either).
- `POST /api/v1/inject-message` (`annex-server.ts:1988-2014`) already sends to chat runtimes for group-project shoulder taps.

## Proposed approach

- Share one main-side helper between `chat-handlers.ts` and Annex for sending to a chat agent (delivery handling, `/clear`, revert guard), so the two paths cannot drift again.
- Extend `POST /agents/:id/message` with optional `delivery` and return `{ delivery, messageId }` for chat agents. Keep the existing fields for older callers.
- Add `POST /api/v1/agents/:id/chat/interrupt` (mTLS) → `runtime.interrupt()`.
- Controller: `annexClient.chatSend(satelliteId, agentId, text, delivery)` and `chatInterrupt(...)` through `annex-client.ts` → IPC → preload; `chatStore` routes remote ids to them (backend switch from #2393).
- Stop/sleep is covered by #2394.

## Acceptance criteria

- From the controller ChatView: send while idle starts a turn; send while running steers or queues as the composer chooses; Stop interrupts the turn on the satellite.
- `/clear` sent over Annex clears context the same way as a local send (unit test).
- A send rejected by the satellite (revert running, agent asleep, not chat) shows the satellite's error text in the composer.
- Route tests: mTLS required for message and interrupt; bearer gets 403 when TLS is on.
- `pty:input` behavior for PTY agents unchanged.

## Dependencies

- #2393 (for the UI). The main-side routes can land first.
title: [MEDIUM] Annex: send, steer, queue and interrupt for remote chat agents
